propositions: Four test guards redundantly invoke _run_request_sites() each, re-deriving the same immutable whole-tree AST analysis of src/rebar, causing 46.45 seconds of cumulative wall time across four ~12-second test runs.

The _verdict function's parameter-provenance branch re-walks the entire src/rebar tree once per parameter-provenance site and re-parses every file, causing ~8,033 parses in a single scan of a much smaller tree.
Per-file AST parsing is repeated across _run_request_sites, _functions, and _verdict caller scan, each independently reading and parsing the entire src/rebar tree.

Caching _run_request_sites via a session-scoped pytest fixture and memoizing per-path parse results via functools.cache reduces module wall time from 50.14s to 5.96s and single-scan time from 11.83s to 4.14s without changing analysis output or assertion semantics.
The analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source; no test mutates the tree and the only autouse fixture patches llm_config._read_llm_file_table which the AST scan does not consult.
